title: valeriana dageletiana var. integra
intro: Valeriana dageletiana var. integra, commonly known as a variety of the Valerian plant, is a type of flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce stress and anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana dageletiana var. integra include sedative, anxiolytic, and spasmolytic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as valepotriates, isovaleramide, and valerenic acid. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to interact with the nervous system and promote a sense of calm and well-being.
